assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one isolated game-map restaurant sprite, MAP_REST_LANCHES, on genuine transparent RGBA.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved Cogna hub concept, style and small central restaurant architecture reference only. Image 2 is the approved opening concept, casual restaurant fitout reference only. Image 3 is the current empty central plot in the approved map assembly, camera/palette reference only. Never reproduce those scenes or their UI.
Subject: ONE compact, single-story contemporary neighborhood restaurant, rectangular flat roof, ivory walls, plain broad violet #6D28D9 fascia and matching purple fabric awning, warm amber glass storefront, dark plum slim window frames. Casual practical interior with a small counter visible through the windows. Absolutely no writing or symbols on the fascia. Entry is a narrow glazed door on the RIGHT facing facade, close to the rightmost corner, clearly visible threshold. The other front face has two large windows. No people.
Composition: full isolated building centered on a square canvas, transparent around it, comfortable small margin, about 78% canvas width. Elevated orthographic oblique editorial city-map view from southeast. Roof diamond back corner upper-middle, right corner to the right, foreground corner lower-middle, left corner to the left. Both ground axes diagonal approximately 27 degrees to horizontal; vertical walls straight up. Right-facing facade goes from rightmost corner down-left to foreground corner, doorway at roughly one third of that face from rightmost corner. Building has a thin foundation directly under the walls, no surrounding paving tile, no landscape or pedestal. Low roof parapet, no roof sign structure, modest roof air-conditioning unit. The exact structure will be reused for two facade variants, so a simple stable silhouette is essential.
Style/medium: polished hand-drawn adult editorial cartoon matching the provided map. Precise dark muted plum outlines, controlled soft painted color, cream masonry, rich purple, warm glazing. Readable at 230 pixels wide. Warm upper-left lighting, local shadows only.
Constraints: restaurant only, architecture entire and uncropped; alpha zero outside. No terrace furniture, plants, outdoor pots, people, vehicles, ground patch, roads, other buildings, food props, letters, logos, labels, icons, menus, border, checkerboard, colored backdrop, ambient ground shadow outside the building. Preserve compact low building proportions. Output one sprite, never a sheet.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE separate small foreground vegetation/props sprite for an editorial city map, transparent RGBA.
Input image 1 is a camera/color style reference only, never reproduce its restaurant. Input image 2 is approved art style reference only.
Subject: a compact continuous grouping of TWO low rectangular warm ivory stone planters with lush low rounded teal/olive shrubs, beside a small dark walnut outdoor bench with plum metal legs. Group arranged along one ground diagonal from upper-left toward lower-right (about 25 degrees), the front-facing rim clearly visible. Planters are short (roughly knee height), shrub clusters round and stylized, bench sized proportionally. Simple foliage rather than photoreal detail. Small upper-left warm highlights and local self-shadow inside the props.
Composition: elevated orthographic oblique editorial city-map camera matching image1, vertically upright props, compact width about twice the height. Entire group isolated centered on transparent square canvas, modest empty margin. This group will be reduced to about 110x65 pixels and placed across the lower-left/front base of the restaurant on the existing terrain. It should softly occlude only a little of the base; not the entrance. Do not generate a construction or a ground tile. No tall tree, no outdoor lights, no street/pavement slab or pedestal, no surrounding landscape. No ground shadow outside group.
Style: polished hand-drawn adult editorial cartoon, muted plum outline, controlled painted greens, ivory planter material, warm upper-left lighting. No text, symbols, labels, logos, frames, UI, people, buildings, vehicles, checkerboard or backdrop. True alpha zero outside. ONE foreground cluster, not separate panels or a spritesheet.
